title: MangaNFTService
tagline: Upload PDFs on our platform to convert to epub & upload to storage servers/IPFS. Create collections w/ erc721. Buy, sell, rent, browse. Full access for NFT holders; sample pages for others.
description: On our platform, you can upload a PDF to convert it to epub data and upload it to storage servers and IPFS. Additionally, you can create collections (contracts) using erc721. Enjoy the ability to buy, sell, rent, and browse content. Full access to all pages is granted exclusively to NFT holders, while others can preview sample pages before purchasing an NFT.
how_its_made: Although experienced engineers can decipher a significant amount of information from blockchain data, we've implemented a unique feature for our manga NFTs. By embedding an encryption program into the contract, we've ensured that only holders can view the full content, keeping all pages secure and private.
